title: CERTIFICATION FOR CHANGE OF USE OF A FRESH FOOD STORE
previewText: A FRESH food store for which a certification has been issued pursuant to Section 63-30 may be changed to any use permitted by the underlying district upon certification by the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission that such change of use would not create a new non-compliance, increase the degree of non-compliance of buildings on the zoning lot, or result in fewer accessory off-street parking spaces than require

blocks.html: A FRESH food store for which a certification has been issued pursuant to Section 63-30 may be changed to any use permitted by the underlying district upon certification by the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission that such change of use would not create a new non-compliance, increase the degree of non-compliance of buildings on the zoning lot, or result in fewer accessory off-street parking spaces than required by the new use pursuant to Section 63-24 (Required Accessory Off-street Parking Spaces in Certain Districts).
blocks.plainText: A FRESH food store for which a certification has been issued pursuant to Section 63-30 may be changed to any use permitted by the underlying district upon certification by the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission that such change of use would not create a new non-compliance, increase the degree of non-compliance of buildings on the zoning lot, or result in fewer accessory off-street parking spaces than required by the new use pursuant to Section 63-24 (Required Accessory Off-street Parking Spaces in Certain Districts).

blocks.html: If a certification pursuant to this Section is granted, a notice of cancellation, in a form acceptable to the Department of City Planning, of the declaration of restrictions recorded pursuant to Section 63-30 shall be executed and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York against all tax lots comprising the former FRESH food store.
blocks.plainText: If a certification pursuant to this Section is granted, a notice of cancellation, in a form acceptable to the Department of City Planning, of the declaration of restrictions recorded pursuant to Section 63-30 shall be executed and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York against all tax lots comprising the former FRESH food store.
